snippet.title: Heroes of Science and Fiction - Release Date Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
The full version of Heroes of Science and Fiction will go live on Steam on 17th March 2026!

Get Heroes of Science and Fiction on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2147380/Heroes_of_Science_and_Fiction/

About Heroes of Science & Fiction:
Explore rich, but dangerous planets in this HoMM-like! Gather resources and expand your base into high-tech stronghold. Raise powerful armies and outsmart your opponents in tactical turn-based battles!

https://heroesofscienceandfiction.com/

Join the community:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/qaQQat2dbC
